_README: Where gitleaks' inline allow marker may appear (#774). gitleaks skips every
finding on a line that carries the marker, so a marker beside a real key
would hide it. 04_tools/gitleaks_allow.py reads this file. It fails on any
marker in a tracked file that no entry names, on an entry that covers more
than one line, and on any marked line a commit in the run's range adds
that no entry names, even if a later commit deletes it. An entry that
matches no marker warns. An entry is a path plus text its line must also
hold (8 characters or more), so it survives the line moving but not a new
line. secret-scan.yml judges a pull request by the base commit's checker
and this file, and validates the pull request's copy of this file with
it, so a pull request cannot widen its own list: add the entry in one pull
request, then the marker in the next.
